name: Ray of Sickness
description:
You project a ray of sickening greenish energy at a creature within medium range. Roll Lore vs Fortitude against the creature. On a win, the creature becomes Weary for the next minute.

Describe the sickness.
successes:
✨: The creature takes 1d4 damage.

🌞: The creature rolls Injury.

💀: You become the target of the spell.

improvements.name: Ray of Enfeeblement
improvements.description: You may spend 1 additional MP when you cast the spell. If you do, on a win, for the next minute, any time the creature deals damage with a melee attack, halve the damage.
